row.team_price_text: Pro: $450/mo flat, billed annually (unlimited editor seats)
row.evidence: Mintlify's pricing page lists "SSO, SCIM & RBAC" only under Enterprise ("Contact us"), and the SCIM docs say "SCIM requires an Enterprise plan."
row.notes: Starter is free (5 editor seats); Pro is a flat $450/mo billed annually ($540 monthly) with unlimited editor seats, so per-user prices are null. Dashboard SSO, SCIM, RBAC and audit logs are Enterprise-only. SCIM is a generic SCIM 2.0 bearer-token endpoint; Okta setup uses Okta's SCIM 2.0 Test App (Header Auth), other IdPs via support. Groups map to viewer/editor/admin roles. The REST API (Pro+) has no user-management endpoints.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free tier with 5 editor seats; the platform REST API needs Pro or Enterprise.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat price with unlimited editor seats. REST API included but it has no member-management endpoints.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit logs (dashboard, CSV export, streaming to S3/Datadog) are Enterprise; no audit-log REST endpoint is documented.

auth.token_source: Dashboard > Settings > Security > SCIM > Configure SCIM (token shown once; Rotate token available)

deprovision.notes: Okta 'deactivate' is enabled; the docs do not say whether Mintlify removes the member or only deactivates them. Manual removal deletes access and the member's keys.

roles.how: Group-to-role mappings in the dashboard: each IdP group name pushed over SCIM maps to viewer, editor or admin; highest-privilege role wins.

limitations.text: Only Okta has step-by-step instructions (via Okta's SCIM 2.0 Test App (Header Auth)); other IdPs must contact Mintlify support.
Disabling SCIM leaves existing members with their current access until removed manually.
Group names are case-sensitive and must match the Mintlify mapping exactly.

scim.notes: Docs say SCIM manages who has access and SSO controls sign-in; they do not make SSO a prerequisite. Base URL is generated per organization in the dashboard and not published.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs are viewable/exportable to CSV and streamable to Amazon S3 or Datadog on Enterprise; no REST endpoint is listed.

user_api.notes: Mintlify's platform REST API (Pro or Enterprise) covers deployments, agent jobs, assistant and analytics exports; its endpoint list has no member, group or role management.

okta.notes: No Mintlify OIN app (okta.com/integrations/mintlify returned 404); Mintlify documents Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App (Header Auth) and a custom SAML 2.0 app.

entra.notes: Mintlify's SSO guide creates a non-gallery Entra app for SAML; no Entra SCIM steps documented (Learn tutorial URL 404).

google.notes: Google Workspace SAML is set up via Mintlify support; no Google provisioning.

citations.title: SCIM user provisioning - Mintlify
citations.quote: Mintlify's SCIM endpoint works with any SCIM 2.0-compliant identity provider that authenticates with a bearer token. Step-by-step instructions below cover Okta.

citations.title: SCIM user provisioning - Mintlify
citations.quote: Click **Configure SCIM**. Mintlify generates a **SCIM base URL** and a **bearer token**.

citations.title: SCIM user provisioning - Mintlify
citations.quote: Securely store the bearer token. Mintlify shows it only once and cannot display it again.

citations.title: SCIM user provisioning - Mintlify
citations.quote: In Okta, under **Applications**, click **Browse App Catalog** and search for **SCIM 2.0 Test App (Header Auth)**.

citations.title: SCIM user provisioning - Mintlify
citations.quote: Under **Provisioning to app**, enable the create, update, and deactivate options you want Okta to manage.

citations.title: SCIM user provisioning - Mintlify
citations.quote: In Okta, use your existing groups or create new ones for each set of users you want to provision, then push those groups to the SCIM app under **Push groups**.

citations.title: SCIM user provisioning - Mintlify
citations.quote: When a user belongs to multiple mapped groups, Mintlify assigns the highest-privilege role among them.

citations.title: SCIM user provisioning - Mintlify
citations.quote: Rotating the token immediately invalidates the previous token.
